compliance.emc: FCC 47 CFR Part 15 Class A, EN 55022 Class A, ICES-003 Class A, VCCI Class A, AS/NZS CISPR 22 Class A, CISPR 22 Class A, EN 55024, EN 300386, CE
compliance.nebs: GR-1089-CORE EMC and electrical safety for network telecommunications equipment (listed by the datasheet; no level stated)

environmental.acoustic-noise: 53.7 dBA with a 1400 W AC AFO supply (datasheet Table 3, ISO 7779 at 23 C)
environmental.altitude: up to 3049 m operating (10,000 ft); 4877 m non-operating
environmental.humidity: 10 to 85 percent noncondensing operating; 0 to 95 percent non-operating
environmental.operating-temp: 0 to 45 C (32 to 113 F) for AFO models

features.macsec: IEEE 802.1AE MACsec AES256 on all access and uplink ports
features.optics-qsfp: 40GbE QSFP+ SR4 (multimode) and DAC direct-attach copper (datasheet, Supported Optics)
features.poe: all 48 ports up to 95 W, the datasheet's pre-standard IEEE 802.3bt PoE++
features.uplink-module: one slot; 2-port 40-Gigabit QSFP+ / 100-Gigabit QSFP28 EX-UM-2QSFP-MR or 4-port 1/10-Gigabit SFP+ EX-UM-4SFPP-MR (neither is part of the shipping configuration)
features.virtual-chassis: up to 10 members; the four rear QSFP+ ports are dedicated Virtual Chassis ports and cannot be network ports; joins an EX4300 Virtual Chassis only through a 40-Gigabit port of the other members, and must take the primary role there

management.console: mini-USB on the front, RJ-45 CON on the rear
management.oob: MGMT RJ-45 with link activity and status lamps (rear)
management.reset: pinhole Reset button on the rear
management.usb: one USB port on the rear

performance.airflow-cfm: fan 22 CFM, each power supply 7.5 CFM; 59 CFM total with two supplies (datasheet, stated for the line)

physical.depth-no-psu: 467.0 mm (18.39 in, 46.7 cm) with no power supply or uplink module (Table 10)
physical.depth-with-uplink: 509.6 mm (20.06 in, 50.96 cm) with a power supply and an uplink module (Table 10)
physical.uplink-module-weight: 0.57 lb (0.26 kg) for the 2-port EX-UM-2QSFP-MR and for the 4-port EX-UM-4SFPP-MR
physical.weight: 16.42 lb (7.45 kg) with no power supply and no fan module (guide Table 10)

power.poe-budget: 1030 W available with one 1400 W supply (guide Table 35); the datasheet gives 1100 W
power.psu-redundancy: N+0 or N+N; up to two supplies, one is enough for the chassis

configs.description: EX4300-48MP as shipped - one 1400 W AC power supply (AIR OUT) in slot 0 with a cover panel over slot 1, two EX4300-48MP-FAN (AIR OUT) fan modules, and the uplink slot covered. Front-to-back airflow.
configs.name: ac

configs.description: EX4300-48MP-S - the spare chassis, shipped with no power supply and no fan module; AC supplies are ordered separately, with AIR OUT fans, and the datasheet's spare-chassis matrix says which combinations are supported. The supply and fan bays are shown open.
configs.name: s

gaps.wanted: Where the protective earthing terminal sits on the left side of the chassis and its hole pitch. The guide's Figure 15 note says it is on the left side, and Table 69 gives a two-hole lug with 10-32 screws; no side face is drawn. A side photograph or a dimensioned drawing settles it.
A straight-on studio photograph of the rear. The maker's image library holds none for this model, so the rear is read off the flat callout figure and the supply art follows the other EX4300 supplies.
The bracket positions of the front-mounting brackets: no figure in the guide dimensions them against the face, so no ear position or kit is listed.
The EX-UM-2QSFP-MR and EX-UM-4SFPP-MR uplink modules and their ports, left for the later uplink-module slice; the bay takes only the cover panel here.
The QR code (guide Figure 12 callout 1) is a unique printed label; the photograph shows only its two corner marks and no code, so none is drawn.
One PoE budget for the model: the datasheet gives 1100 W and the guide's Table 35 1030 W with one 1400 W supply. Both are transcribed.
The depth with a power supply fitted: the guide's Table 10 gives 19.64 in (49.88 cm) and the datasheet 19.63 in (49.99 cm). The guide's pair of units agrees and is used.

The datasheet's spare-chassis matrix marks a 550 W DC AFO supply as a supported combination for the EX4300-48MP-S; the guide and the datasheet's own power options say the 48MP takes no DC supply. The bays refuse the DC supply.

a `power-draw-max-w` on each module this chassis accepts, from the vendor's own per-card table - Cisco publishes one per ambient, most vendors publish none, and until they land a module total is a floor
one of `power-max-w`, `power-max-ac-w`, `power-max-dc-w` in `attrs.power` (profile `networking` - see spec/schemas/profiles.yaml) - unlocks the About panel, and comparison against other devices
`physical-context` on 5 bays (front 1, rear 4); `physical-context` on port groups rj45, rj45-10g - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays

airflow.note: Guide Tables 7, 27, 28 and 31: AIR OUT (AFO) is front-to-back; this model ships AFO fan modules and an AFO supply (Table 3), and the guide says it takes front-to-back airflow only. There is no AFI or DC variant and so no back-to-front configuration. The handle colour of the fan and supply is not stated by the guide (searched for orange and blue), so no handle colour is claimed.

chassis.note: Guide Table 10 and the datasheet: height 1.72 in (4.37 cm) = 43.7 mm; width 17.36 in (44.1 cm) = 441.0 mm, "the outer edges of the front-mounting brackets extend the width to 19 in", so 441.0 is the body between the bracket flanges. Depth for the EX4300-48MP, which has its own line in Table 10: 18.39 in (46.7 cm) with no power supply or uplink module, 19.64 in (49.88 cm) with a power supply installed and 20.06 in (50.96 cm) with a power supply and an uplink module. THE DATASHEET DISAGREES on the middle figure and prints 19.63 in (49.99 cm), whose two units differ from each other by 1.1 mm; the guide's own pair agrees (19.64 in is 498.9 mm), so the guide's 49.88 cm is used. The modelled depth is 498.8 mm, the figure with the power supply fitted, as shipped; the other two are in attrs. 1RU.

colour.note: The face is #898d94, the 4300 family's value from the median of bare plate in the 24-port photograph. The 48MP photograph reads the plate between #7b8088 in the left margin and #959398 beside the status block under its lighting, which is the same grey; the family value is used.

ears.note: NOT MODELLED. The guide's inventory (Table 68) ships two mounting brackets and mounting screws and says the switch mounts in a two-post or four-post rack; the datasheet lists the kits EX-4PST-RMK (adjustable four-post), EX-RMK (rack-mount) and EX-WMK (wall-mount) as separate items. For this model the guide says to align the front-mounting brackets 17.5 mm offset from the front panel (Figure 55), but no figure dimensions the bracket against the face, so no ear position is written and no rail kit is listed in chassis.kits. The kit part numbers are recorded here for the later dedupe.

front-ports.note: 48 jacks in two stacked rows, four blocks of six columns. The dark jack cavities of the top row read, in mm from the left edge of the face, first columns at 14.49, 103.5, 194.6 and 288.0 and a column pitch of 13.97 (the registry's ganged-jack pitch, 0.550 in). The gutters between the blocks are NOT equal: 5.2 mm (the first two blocks), 7.3 mm (between the second and third, where the orange outline begins) and 9.65 mm (between the third and fourth). They are written as two blocks of 24, each with its own gutter, and the 7.3 mm step as the second block's start. The rows centre 15.9 and 29.9 mm down: the photograph reads 15.5 and 29.3 for the cavities and the 4300-48P's layout was found to sit 0.5 mm higher than its photograph's cavities, so the same offset is applied; the row step of 14.0 is the photograph's 13.9. The top row is the same part turned 180 so that its keyway is up, as the photograph shows lamp tabs above the upper jacks and below the lower. The orange outline round the last two blocks (the multigigabit half) is read at 1.6 mm outside the jack shells.

fru-bays.note: Two power supply bays (PSU 0, PSU 1) and two fan bays (0, 1), each seating the guide's FRU parts. No supply or fan is built into the chassis: all are FRUs. The guide's Figure 15 draws slot 0 with a supply and slot 1 as an empty slot; the cover panel the guide ships for an empty supply slot is seated in slot 1 as shipped. The bays take the 715 W, 1100 W and 1400 W AC AIR OUT supplies and the cover panel (guide Power Supplies: "EX4300-48MP and EX4300-48MP-S switches support 715 W, 1100 W, and 1400 W AC power supplies"). The 350 W supplies and every DC supply are refused (guide, Table 30 note and DC Power Supply note).

gate-1-front.note: THE FRONT PHOTOGRAPH PASSES. ex4300-48mp-front-high.jpg shows the face 1446 px across (x 26 to 1471), which with the stated 441.0 mm is 3.279 px per mm; the 13.97 mm jack pitch, measured as 45.8 px between column centres (73.5 to 302.5 over five intervals), gives 3.278, so the scale is confirmed from a feature inside the face. The face stands about 142 px tall (top edge at row 17.5, bottom edge lost in the drop shadow near row 160) against the 143 expected, so it is near-orthographic and carries geometry. Positions are good to about half a millimetre. Figure 12 (g022449, 1501 x 447 px) is a flat drawing and agrees on counts and arrangement.

gate-1-rear.note: THE REAR CALLOUT FIGURE PASSES. Guide Figure 15 (g022450) is a flat rear elevation: its chassis outline is 1404.5 px across (x 17 to 1421.5) and 139.4 px down, aspect 10.07 against 10.09, 3.185 px per mm. Positions on the rear are read off it with a millimetre grid laid over the raster, good to about half a millimetre.

interface-names.note: Not printed and not modelled. The guide's factory-default configuration for the 48MP names the access ports ge-0/0/0 to ge-0/0/47 and the uplink module ports xe-0/2/0 to xe-0/2/3; no table names the QSFP+ Virtual Chassis ports.

lamp-legends.note: drawing-vs-photo, and the PHOTOGRAPH wins: the guide's text names the chassis lamps in the order ALM, SYS and MST, but the photograph prints SYS, ALM and MST from top to bottom, and that order is drawn. The photograph also prints the four port mode legends the guide's Figure 12 callout 4 only names.

lifecycle.note: Searched for an end-of-life notice on 2026-10-23. Third-party trackers (endoflife.ai, eoltracking.com) report a Juniper notice of 2026-06-29 for the EX4300-48MP and EX4600 with a last order date of 2026-12-29 and end of support on 2031-12-29. Juniper's own bulletin was not reached, so the dates are estimated.

other-faces.note: No source draws the top, bottom or sides flat: the guide's front and rear figures show them in perspective with a logo on the lid and mounting holes in the sides. Each carries an `empty` sentence.

port-lamps.note: Guide, Network Port, Built-In QSFP+ Port, Uplink Port, and Uplink Module Port LEDs, Figure 30 and Tables 21 and 25: each port has two lamps, a Link activity lamp (green, blinking with activity, steady when linked) and a Status lamp whose meaning is chosen with the Factory Reset/Mode button (SPD, DX, EN or POE). The lamps are the jack housing's two corner windows (common/rj45-ganged-eth) and carry that component's default vocabulary. Which window is which on this hardware is not stated by any document held, so the pairing is the component's convention. The multigigabit half's speed lamp shows green for 1000 Mbps, amber for 5000 and blue for 10000 (Table 25).

port-numbering.note: The photograph prints the numbers in orange pairs under each column: 0 and 1 under the first column, 2 and 3 under the second, up to 46 and 47, with the even number set higher and the odd lower beside it. The even number belongs to the upper jack and the odd to the lower, so numbering runs down each column and then across. Ports 0 to 23 are the 10/100/1000BASE-T half and 24 to 47 the 100/1000/2500/5000/10000BASE-T half inside the orange outline (guide Table 3; the photograph's outline starts at 24). The photograph's numerals sit 0.7 mm left of the column centre (even) and 1.9 mm right of it (odd); they are drawn at the centre and 2.3 mm right, the offsets of the other EX4300 devices, which is within 0.7 mm. Their height reads 37.8 mm (even) and 38.8 mm (odd) down. The numeral colour reads #ff8074 and the outline #ff7b4c in the photograph. The guide's CLI interface names are not printed on the metal and are not modelled; the photograph prints no block legends.

power.note: Guide Table 35. The base power the system needs before PoE is 300 W; with one 1400 W supply 1330 W is usable, 1030 W is available for PoE, enough for 34 ports at PoE+ or 10 at PoE++, and with two 1400 W supplies 2000 W is usable and 1700 W available for all 48 ports at PoE+ and 17 at PoE++. At low line the 1400 W supply operates as 1100 W. The datasheet orders the switch as "provides up to 1100 W PoE++ power" and its Table 1 gives 1100 W: the guide's 1030 W and the datasheet's 1100 W are two documents' statements of a PoE budget, transcribed and not reconciled. No typical or maximum draw of the switch itself is stated by either document.

psu-seating.note: The datasheet's spare-chassis matrix row for the EX4300-48MP-S reads X, Y, Y, Y, Y, X, X across its seven supply columns, which puts a Y under the 550 W DC AFO supply. The guide says in three places that the 48MP takes no DC supply, the datasheet's own Power Options list only 715, 1100 and 1400 W AC supplies for it, and the matrix's 550 W column is read as a printing slip; the bays refuse the DC supply. Recorded as a gap.

rear.note: Guide Figure 15 (g022450), 3.185 px per mm, rear seen from behind with x = 0 at the left of the drawing: the management jack 7.4 to 24.7 mm and the USB port below it, the console jack 26.3 to 42.9, the ESD point at (33.9, 8.3) with its symbol to the right, a reset pinhole at (34.5, 37.4) with RESET printed below, fan module 0 from 53.0 and fan module 1 from 201.8 (each 41.2 to 41.7 mm across), four QSFP+ ports of 20.4 mm outline on a 22.57 mm pitch from 103.6, each with a 4 x 4 field of small square vents above it and two lamps between, power supply slot 0 from 252.5 and slot 1 from 349.6 (where the cover's frame begins), each 84.0 mm wide (slot 0's module reads 252.8 to 335, its rail ends at 345.7), serial number and CLEI code labels (callouts 4 and 5) above the QSFP block at 107.3 to 128.2 and 128.3 to 156.5, and three chassis screws. The QSFP+ pitch is the figure's, not the registry's 19.0, and it is the first model where the pitch is this wide.

rear-ground.note: The guide's Figure 15 note says the protective earthing terminal is located on the left side of the chassis, which no face drawn here shows. It is not modelled; see gaps.

rear-qsfp-lamps.note: Guide Figure 15 and Figure 32: each QSFP+ port has two lamps above it, a Link activity lamp and a Status lamp (Table 24: steady green when the 40-Gigabit port is up). Eight circles between the vent field and the cage, each pair 3.9 mm apart about its port's centre. The lamps' roles within a pair are not stated.

sources.note: EX4300 Switch Hardware Guide, Juniper Networks, published 2025-08-12 (414 pages; https://www.juniper.net/documentation/us/en/hardware/ex4300/ex4300.pdf): Figures 6 and 8 (isometric panel drawings), Figures 12 and 15 (flat callout figures g022449 and g022450), Table 3 and Table 8 (the 48MP models and what each ships with), Tables 6 and 7 (uplink modules and supply airflow), Table 10 (chassis size and weight), Tables 18 to 29 (LEDs), Tables 27, 28, 30, 31 and 46 (fans and supplies), Table 35 (power budget), Table 68 (cover panels) and Figures 100 and 103 (the 48MP's own supply and fan module). EX4300 Line of Ethernet Switches Datasheet (https://www.juniper.net/content/dam/www/assets/datasheets/us/en/switches/ex4300-line-of-ethernet-switches-datasheet.pdf, 17 pages, PDF created 2022-07-25): Table 1 (models), Table 2 (spare-chassis matrix), Table 3 (acoustics), physical and environmental specifications, ordering information. Juniper's straight-on studio photograph ex4300-48mp-front-high.jpg (1500 x 206 px, https://www.juniper.net/content/dam/www/assets/images/us/en/image-library/ex-series/ex4300-48mp/ex4300-48mp-front-high.jpg) from its image library; the rear photograph ex4300-48mp-rear-high.jpg returned an HTML 404 page, tried once, so no studio photograph of the rear exists. Both documents and the photograph were fetched from juniper.net on 2026-10-23; the documents carry the sha256 values below. The held intake folders for Juniper (exqfx, mx/visio) are not present on this host, so no held photograph, stencil or model was used. Terms of use: the guide, datasheet and photograph are Juniper's, published for customers; none of it is copied into the library, only transcribed facts and new drawings.

status-block.note: Read off the photograph at 3.279 px per mm with the face's left edge at 0: the status plate 370.5 to 439.5 x 2.2 to 17.4 mm; the EX4300-48MP legend starting at 372.6 and baseline 7.0 mm (plain text, drawn); the mini-USB console jack centred at (408.6, 5.9) with no legend beside it; the three chassis lamps at x 419.7, y 4.5, 8.1 and 11.6 with SYS, ALM and MST printed to their left; the four port mode lamps at x 423.4, y 4.5, 8.1, 11.6 and 15.0 with SPD, DX, EN and POE printed to their right; the Factory Reset/Mode button centred at (433.0, 6.0), 4.7 mm across, carrying a list icon. Each is placed by eye on that photograph. The "Running Junos" mark below the model name and the vendor mark at the left are not drawn; each has a logo-zone. The two corner marks that frame a QR code (guide Figure 12 callout 1) are not drawn and the code is not carried: it is a unique printed label.

uplink-slot.note: Every EX4300 24-port, 32-port and 48-port switch has one front-panel uplink module slot (guide, Uplink Modules in EX4300 Switches); uplink modules are not part of the shipping configuration and the guide's inventory (Table 68) says a cover panel for the slot is provided. The 48MP's slot opening is 370.7 to 437.3 x 17.7 to 42.2 mm (66.6 x 24.5) below the status plate, and the photograph shows it covered. The guide's Table 6 supports two modules in it, the 2-port 40/100-Gigabit EX-UM-2QSFP-MR and the 4-port 1/10-Gigabit EX-UM-4SFPP-MR, neither of which is in the library; the bay takes only the cover panel here and both are left for a later slice.

variants.note: The guide's 48MP models are EX4300-48MP and EX4300-48MP-S (Tables 3 and 8). Both share this front panel, so each is a configuration of this device: ac and s. The guide's other models (EX4300-24T, -24P, -48T, -48P and their -S, -AFI and -DC variants) are separate devices on main, and the EX4300-32F is the first device of this slice.
